extracted.intended_audience: Users of Mathematics Stack Exchange who want to ask or tag questions about mathematical notation
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for asking or tagging questions about the meaning, history, and usage of mathematical symbols and notation on Mathematics Stack Exchange; advises on scope, required context, and preliminary research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: suitable question topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions on the meaning, history, and usage of mathematical symbols and notation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the tag for queries about what a symbol means, its historical origin, or how it is used in mathematics. This defines the topical scope of the tag.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide context / source where encountered
rubrics_metrics.description: Please remember to mention where (book, paper, webpage, etc.) you encountered any mathematical notation you are asking about.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When asking, state the exact source or location (textbook, paper, webpage, etc.) where you saw the notation so answerers can see intended meaning or conventions in context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do preliminary research in canonical references
rubrics_metrics.description: Before asking a question on the site, please check if you can find your answer in Earliest Uses of Various Mathematical Symbols or the book A History of Mathematical Notations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these standard references (and similar resources) first to avoid asking questions whose answers are already documented. If you still need help, mention what you checked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the original source (textbook/paper) for notation explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, a textbook or paper usually takes the time to explain the notation they're using; please remember to mention where you've seen the notation you are asking about.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look at the immediate source (the book or article) since authors often define or explain nonstandard notation there; report that you checked it and what it did/ did not clarify.
